7084-7272-7893.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
7084-7272-7893.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil triggers, creating a 1/1 green Elf creature token
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2023-4289-4518-6791.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-8174.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Mabel.
When Mabel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mabel enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

628-2018-2412.description:
Activate Crosis's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Crosis's Attendant dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Crosis's Attendant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Crosis's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Crosis's Attendant dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Crosis's Attendant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Repeat

1170-2829-5131-6289--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2829-5131-6289--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Voyager Quickwelder.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-5231-6566--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
When the creature token dies, Yuna triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-5295-6006-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1621-3375-6867-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

803-5256-5659-6483.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dark Revenant.
When Dark Revenant dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Dark Revenant's power, which will cause you to mill Dark Revenant.
As Dark Revenant is a Lhurgoyf due to Arcane Adaptation, Disa's first ability triggers, returning Dark Revenant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3227-3378-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
3227-3378-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying {3}{U}, blinking Scrivener and Peregrine Drake and causing you to draw a card.
When Scrivener and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Scrivener trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
3227-3378-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

406-6428.notablePrerequisites: You have more cards in hand than your maximum hand size.
406-6428.description:
During the next cleanup step, discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Magmakin Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent for each card discarded this way.
Magmakin Artillerist triggers, causing you to draw a card.
As you are still in the cleanup step, once the stack is empty and priority has been passed by all players, you will discard down to your maximum hand size again.
Repeat from step 2.

140-7074-7433.description:
Activate Koh by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

206-1563-2351-6460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
206-1563-2351-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

851-1563-3899-5223.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

3110-3532-5078-6607.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lorescale Coatl triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4050-5010-6594-7028.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

3532-3949-5078-6289.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3949-5078-6289.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

2034-2267-3129-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2267-3129-5220-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Tormod triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2034-3693-3836-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

997-5968-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

457-5078-5390-6747.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Forensic Gadgeteer triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Clue, adding {U}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library.
Repeat.

3951-4192-4365-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-4192-4365-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1606-3995-5963.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
1606-3995-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Ley Weaver's ability by tapping it, untapping two lands you control.
Activate the two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

225-880-4862.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
225-880-4862.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control.
If the creature was an Elemental, Omnath triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Omnath and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

804-3719-4893-5326.manaNeeded: {U}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
804-3719-4893-5326.notablePrerequisites: Sakashima the Impostor has a power of at least 2.
804-3719-4893-5326.description:
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} plus command tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Sakashima the Impostor and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Sakashima the Impostor to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

575-1207-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Forest.
575-1207-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a nontoken Forest, which is a creature due to Ambush Commander, adding {R}.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Repeat.

1978-2364-4324.description:
Animate Mana Vault using Workshop Elders.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mana Vault.
Repeat from step 2.

974-2136-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-2136-3525.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Smaug with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}{R}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target any other creature(s) you control.

4029-4659-5365-5494.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
4029-4659-5365-5494.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

2732-4681-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide from your graveyard.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 1 and step 3, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1137-2882-3079-4999.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Rith's Attendant.
You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
1137-2882-3079-4999.description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Rith's Attendant due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Hollow One by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {R}{G}{W}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.

1651-2585-2645-2751-4176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional artifacts.
1651-2585-2645-2751-4176.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Karn triggers.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Karn's ability.
Resolve the copy of Karn's ability, adding {C} for each artifact you control that cannot be spent to cast nonartifact spells.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Staff of Domination and Grim Monolith, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Grim Monolith's second ability by paying {4}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

3525-4249-5190.notablePrerequisites:
Nissa's Zendikon and Pemmin's Aura attached to Nykthos.
Your devotion to blue is at least four.
3525-4249-5190.description:
Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Nykthos.
Repeat.

77-795-2559-4399.description:
Activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Brilliant Halo.
Brilliant Halo triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Faith Healer ability, causing you to gain two life.
Cast Brilliant Halo by paying two life, targeting any creature.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

81-2645.notablePrerequisites: Kami of Whispered Hopes does not have summoning sickness, and has power 5 or greater.
81-2645.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
81-2645.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

168-2210-4753-5290.description:
Cast Mirrormade by paying {2}{U}.
Mirrormade enters the battlefield as a copy of Oblivion Ring, triggering Sage of Mysteries and itself.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing target player to mill two cards.
Resolve the Mirrormade's trigger, exiling Oblivion Ring.
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield as a copy of the Oblivion Ring copy, triggering Sage of Mysteries and itself.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing target player to mill two cards.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator's trigger, exiling Mirrormade.
Mirrormade leaves the battlefield, triggering itself, returning Oblivion Ring from exile to the battlefield.
Sage of Mysteries and Oblivion Ring trigger.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing target player to mill two cards.
Resolve the Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling Clever Impersonator.
Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield, returning Mirrormade from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 until each opponent has an empty library, then end the loop by choosing to copy or exile any other permanent.

45-1309-1987-2427.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
